flexible_battle_party.name: Flexible Battle Party
flexible_battle_party.description:
Allow required characters to stay in reserve
for boss battles. Your active lineup is kept.

combined_battles.name: Combined Battles
combined_battles.description:
Enemies within 500 units join.
Each extra group adds 50% to EXP,
Gald, Grade and item drop chances.

learn_elemental_artes.name: Learn Elemental Artes
learn_elemental_artes.description:
Learn elemental variants after
50 uses outside Unison.
Turning this off makes everyone
forget their elemental artes.

learn_both_arte_paths.name: Both T/S Arte Paths
learn_both_arte_paths.description:
Learn both T and S arte paths.
Level and use requirements remain.
Turning this off forgets artes
opposite each character's T/S type.

display_mode.name: Display Mode
display_mode.description:
Choose Windowed, Borderless or Fullscreen.
Changes apply immediately.
Confirm within 15 seconds to keep them.

resolution.name: Resolution
resolution.description:
Enter opens the resolution list.
Up/Down highlights; Enter applies.
Confirm the preview within 15 seconds.
Native matches your monitor's resolution.

graphics_backend.name: Graphics Backend
graphics_backend.description:
Choose a supported graphics backend.
Restart the game to apply changes.

anti_aliasing.name: Anti-Aliasing
anti_aliasing.description:
Enter opens the anti-aliasing list.
Up/Down highlights; Enter applies.
Smooth edges without temporal blur.
MSAA and SMAA S2x depend on GPU support.

confirmations.forget_arte_paths:
